content: UDP corruption/detection: kernel verifies UDP checksum and silently drops corrupted datagrams (counted in netstat -su errors); hardware checksum offload means corruption is rare but nonzero; end-to-end CRC (sup-kv envelope crc32 + per-record CRC32) is the right layering since UDP checksum is weak (16-bit ones complement). Drops from checksum failures look identical to loss in simulation - virtual network should model a corrupt class distinct from loss when testing the bad-crc discard path and counters.
